name: 8th Annual SHSMO Holiday Open House
paras: The State Historical Society of Missouri and its Richard Bookstore turn the Center for Missouri Studies into a holiday gathering with local vendors, live caroling by the Columbia Chorale and a morning visit from Santa and the Grinch.
The open house is free and open to the public. Families can browse the art gallery's new exhibitions between photos and shopping.
tip: Go before 11 AM if you want the Santa and Grinch photos, since Santa visits only from 9 to 11.

name: Living Windows Festival in The District
when_note: The Christkindlmarkt at Gunter Hans runs 5 to 10 PM.
paras: Downtown Columbia's annual festival fills The District with live performances, open houses, shopping and holiday window and street decor for two evening hours.

Gunter Hans hosts a Christkindlmarkt with vendors, hot cider, hot chocolate and bretzels. The District also offers free horse drawn carriage rides on weekends in December and free downtown garage parking after 6 PM.
tip: Park in a downtown garage after 6 PM for free and walk the District from window to window.

name: The Polar Express in Hartsburg
when_note: Entry times are 5:30, 6:30 and 7:30 PM. Tickets are limited and refunds are not offered.
paras: Guests visit an authentic MKT caboose in Hartsburg for a Polar Express evening with hot chocolate, cookies, a Christmas craft and a visit with Santa. The train is stationary and does not run.
The event repeats on three Fridays in December in small timed groups, and free parking is available.
tip: Pick your entry time when you buy and book early, since the Eventbrite listing says refunds are not offered.

name: Merry Ol' Missouri: A Family Christmas Spectacular
when_note: The 7 PM start is confirmed for Dec 18. Check the ticket page for the Dec 17 and Dec 19 showtimes.
paras: Show Me Theatricals returns to the Missouri Theatre with a holiday spectacular featuring show-stopping vocals, Rockette-style kick lines, a trip to Santa's workshop and traditional songs of the season. The show runs about 80 minutes with no intermission.
Doors open one hour early so families can meet Santa, visit the merchandise store and grab a snack. Every guest needs a ticket, including lap children and kids under 5 who are admitted free.
tip: Arrive when doors open to meet Santa before the show, and reserve a seat for every child even when admission is free.

name: City of Refuge Holiday Market
paras: City of Refuge's annual outdoor Holiday Market gathers more than 65 local and refugee vendors with food trucks, hot beverages and live entertainment. Santa visits during the day, and the host lists activities for all ages.
The market is free and open to the public on the first Saturday in December, and guests can stop in any time between 10 AM and 4 PM.
tip: Dress for the cold since the market is outdoors, and plan a hot drink stop between vendors.
